scenicChapters.title: Kalkalpen - Hintergebirg → Wallsee - Kastell
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 70 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Wachau Danube Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 34 km this is Wachau Danube Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

places-letreros-de-los-martires-cueva-de.story: A 295 km round trip from Puebla de Don Fadrique - roughly 5 h 05 in the saddle. On the way it passes Zona 1, Las Covachicas, Cueva de las Palamas and Cueva de los Pucheros. The highest point is about 1,400 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
